facts.fact: Human Rights Watch states that on 30 October 2025 Niamey police arrested six journalists (Moussa Kaka and Abdoul Aziz of Radio Television Saraounia, Ibro Chaibou and Souleymane Brah of Voix du Peuple, Youssouf Seriba of Les Echos du Niger, Oumarou Kane of Le Herisson), three of them held at Kollo prison, and charged all six with complicity in circulating a document likely to disturb public order under the 2019 cybercrime law, apparently over sharing on social media an invitation to a state press conference announcing new mandatory levies for the security-forces solidarity fund.
facts.system: Six Nigerien journalists arrested under the 2019 cybercrime law
